'''Yung''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Under New Management" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> Under the leadership of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Herron (Corellia)|Herron]], Yung's squad tried to recover several newly-developed [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation's]] [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation (facility)|facility]] when Imperial forces seized control of the factory, but the mission was a failure because of bad intelligence on the size of the enemy forces. Herron sought aid from other [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces, who were able to infiltrate the factory and open an access tunnel so the unit could enter the facility and steal the shuttles.<ref name="Under New Management" />
